description: This file defines the ContentItemsFieldType class, a GraphQL field type for querying content items within OrchardCore, including filtering, ordering, and pagination logic.

classes.name: ContentItemsFieldType
classes.description: GraphQL field type for querying content items with filtering, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: ResolveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves content items based on GraphQL query arguments, applying filters, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: FilterWhereArgumentsAsync
methods.description: Filters content items based on 'where' arguments using predicates and index aliasing.

methods.name: PageQuery
methods.description: Applies pagination ('first' and 'skip') to the content items query.

methods.name: FilterContentType
methods.description: Filters content items by content type.

methods.name: FilterVersion
methods.description: Filters content items based on publication status.

methods.name: BuildWhereExpressions
methods.description: Builds filter expressions from JSON 'where' input.

methods.name: BuildExpressionsInternal
methods.description: Constructs individual filter expressions from JSON input.

methods.name: OrderBy
methods.description: Applies ordering to the content items query based on 'orderBy' arguments.
